Closed 34 bugs in the March quality sprint (team high), including the Safari checkout bug behind 60+ support tickets.

flag.reasoning: No specific examples or evidence are cited, and the claim is directly contradicted by concrete data elsewhere: peer_E_1 and project_1 document a 42% page-load improvement and accessibility 71→96 that unblocked the Northstar deal; peer_F_1 and project_2 show Arjun closed the most bugs on the team (34) in March. This is also the only manager input (single_source_bias) and meeting_note_3 records limited manager face time since April, suggesting a visibility gap rather than a performance gap.

overall_bias_summary: 1 high-severity flag detected: the manager's negative assessment is unsupported, single-source, and contradicted by concrete peer feedback, goals, and project outcomes. All other points are well-evidenced. Recommend human review of the flagged growth-area claim before approval.
